items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: This is the band to club for us... Joe Akin and Julian Lane and Joe... played in the jewelry business on. Joey's father's name, Joe Schultz.

ctx.x: Who is this band, this big long-hair reading band? Long Hair Reading Band, what's it? Farroni's Band. Farroni's. Is that the WPA band again? Yeah. Oh yeah, I see Felix Financi.

Oh, they had a good band there, boy. This is the band to club for us, you know, like I tell you a lot ago. Joe Akin and Julian Lane and Joe, what's his name, played the violin, played in the jewelry business on. Joey's father's name, Joe Schultz.
